channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Man, 33, charged with attempted murder after officer slashed in Waikiki
item.description: Prosecutors have charged 33-year-old Braxton Rabago with first-degree attempted murder following the Saturday afternoon slashing of a plainclothes police officer in Waikiki.

item.title: Father of accused Georgia school shooter convicted of murder
item.description: ATLANTA >> A man who gave his troubled son a rifle for Christmas that the boy allegedly later used to kill four people at a high school in Georgia was convicted today of 27 charges, including second-degree murder, in a rare U.S. legal case in which a parent was prosecuted following the actions of a child in a mass shooting.

item.title: Waianae building fire intentionally set, HFD says
item.description: The Honolulu Police Department is asking the public for help finding whoever started a fire in a kitchen in a Waianae home early this morning.

item.title: Schatz slams State Department over stranded Americans in Middle East
item.description: WASHINGTON >> U.S. lawmakers today criticized the State Department for urging Americans in the Middle East to evacuate three days after the U.S.-Israeli air war against Iran began, saying the late warning and widespread flight disruptions showed poor planning and “incompetence.”

item.title: U.S. banks on high alert for cyberattacks as Iran war escalates
item.description: WASHINGTON >> The U.S. financial services industry is on heightened alert for potential cyberattacks amid the unfolding U.S. war in Iran, with firms stepping up monitoring for threats that often rise during periods of geopolitical conflict, said executives and analysts.

item.title: Man, 33, dead after extrication from closed area of Volcanoes National Park
item.description: A 33-year-old man is dead following an overnight rescue operation at Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park last week, according to the National Park Service.

item.title: Trump, Rubio offer conflicting reasons for U.S. entry into Iran war
item.description: WASHINGTON >> President Donald Trump said today he ordered U.S. forces to join Israel’s attack on Iran because he believed Iran was about to strike first, contradicting the rationale offered a day earlier by his secretary of state for how the war began.

item.title: Airline, travel industries scramble with fallout from Iran war
item.description: The airline and tourism industries scrambled to deal with the fallout from the escalating U.S. and Israeli air war against Iran, while governments rushed to bring stranded travelers home from the Middle East following the cancellation of more than 20,000 flights in recent days.

item.title: Woman, 76, critical after being pulled from ocean in Waikiki
item.description: A 76-year-old woman was hospitalized after she was pulled from the ocean at Kuhio Beach in Waikiki this afternoon.

item.title: Hawaii island police arrest 3 after gunshots heard near school
item.description: Hawaii island police arrested three men this afternoon on suspicion of second-degree reckless endangering after gunshots were heard near a subdivision in Kailua-Kona.
